title: Cybercom Planners
content:
Overview

Overview of the development process used by most planners developed by Cybercom.

823197703010823066629cybercom_planner_devops_process111https://i-p-e-x.atlassian.net/wikicybercom_planner_devops_process796.0000000000002581.0000000000001

  • A team member picks a story, creates feature branch, and start implementation.
  • Once the implementation is done the team member creates a pull request.
  • Unit tests are executed automatically when pull request is created.
  • The pull request gets reviewed and approved.
  • Team member merges the change.
  • Unit tests are executed automatically on merge.
  • A new version is build and deployed to Test environment.
  • Manual release and regression tests are run.
  • New version is deployed to Staging environment
  • BAT is executed.
  • Deployment to production.
    • Blue / Green deployment, new version is tested before cutover.

Environments

AWS

Most planners run in AWS for the:
Dev, Test, Staging and Demo environments exists in Cybercom owned AWS account. There is no account separation, all environments are run in the same account.
Also the same virtual machine (EC2) is used for all environments.

Prod environment is run in IPEX AWS account, with exception for Översätta where Prod is also run in Cybercom AWS account.

Azure

Vidga run in IPEX Azure.

Environment automation

There is no environment automation. Setup is handled by Cybercom IS/IT and dev team only orders new environments.

Security tasks

  • Penetration test has been conducted as a one time action. No regular tasks exists.

Verification

Automatic tests

  • Unit test performed on pull request and merge.

Manual tests

  • Regression, Release and BAT tests run against different environments.

Security tests

  • No regular security test exists.


Tools

Generic

  • Git / Bitbucket - Source control.
  • Jira - Issue / task tracker.
  • Confluence - Documentation and requiremenst
  • AHA - Requirements
  • Jenkins

On-Prem

Many of the tools are run on-prem at Cybercom

  • Bitbucket
  • Jira
  • Confluence
  • Jenkins

Test

  • Jest - Unit Test
  • Cypress - End to End Test
  • Selenium - Website Test
